description: This file defines the Configuration class within the Aws\EndpointDiscovery namespace. It implements methods to manage and validate configuration settings related to endpoint discovery, including enabling/disabling the feature and setting cache limits.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Handles configuration settings for AWS endpoint discovery, including enabling/disabling the feature and cache size limits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Configuration object with enabled status and cache limit, validating the cache limit.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether endpoint discovery is enabled.

methods.name: getCacheLimit
methods.description: Returns the cache size limit for endpoint discovery.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Exports the configuration settings as an associative array.
